topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I can't believe this happened, I really thought it was a brand-new idea, something totally original. I spent so much time on it, tweaked it, and dreamed about it. Now to find out it’s already patented… it’s like someone’s already dined on the meal you’d been cooking for weeks. I wish I’d dug deeper, done more research. I feel like I let you down, especially after you were so excited and supportive every step of the way. We’ll figure this out, though. There’s got to be a way around this, right? Maybe we can still make this thing fly, just not exactly the way we planned. I promise I won’t give up just yet.
